explanation: Generate each term by scanning maximal runs in the previous term and appending the run length followed by its digit. Repeat until reaching the requested term.
timeComplexity: O(sum of lengths of generated terms) Each next term scans all runs of the preceding term once; summing these lengths counts the full work.
spaceComplexity: O(maximum generated term length) Only the current term and the next term under construction coexist.
attribution: Unmodified EPIJudge reference source: epi_judge_java_solutions/epi/LookAndSay.java. Original contributors; repository LICENSE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/).
correctness: Every maximal run in a term contributes exactly its decimal length followed by its digit, which is the definition of the next term. Scanning each run once constructs that next term without merging distinct runs; induction over the requested number of terms proves the result.
walkthrough: Start at 1. Successive run descriptions are 11, 21, 1211, 111221 and 312211. Thus term 6 is "312211".
edgeCases: A run count may contain more than one digit.
Counts describe consecutive runs, not total digit frequencies.
